observations: A blocky, segmented figure fills most of the frame, its torso built from stacked rectangular panels in gold, olive, and deep shadow, with white zigzag lines running across each panel.
Two circular yellow eyes sit in a flat, angular head; a dark horizontal band below them shows a row of small rectangular slots.
The background is packed with short, rounded dash-shapes in amber and gold that radiate outward from behind the figure, creating a dense, all-over texture.
reading: The figure stands square-on, arms slightly raised, its body divided into hard-edged plates that catch light unevenly — gold at the outer edges, deep shadow at the joints. White zigzag marks cross each panel like stress lines. The circular eyes and slotted band read as blank and fixed. The radiating background presses close, making the figure feel both monumental and hemmed in.
